entries.en: to float up; to emerge above the water
entries.notes: H 首字「浮/淨」两读、末字「未」与音写 lāy 不合（疑为「來」），据音写拟「浮出來」，故列中等置信。

entries.en: to go out on sentry duty; to set out on coastal patrol
to break out in pox/sores (bubas); to have a pox eruption
to vie to go and do it; to rush out (together) to do something
entries.notes: 西文 giintos/pufia 残损难辨，据 H/M「争去做」定释义。

entries.en: to go out to receive or attend a superior; to pay formal respects
entries.notes: 西文尾字 viene~ 存疑，据 H/M「参见」定释义。

entries.en: to go out to welcome or meet (an arriving dignitary)
for the water to go down or recede (gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: H「掗/拐氣」与音写 cheng gui 及西文均难互证，仅据西文 salir la agua abaxo 拟「水退」，故列低置信。

entries.zh: 冲人脸面；正面撞上人脸
entries.en: to bump or confront someone face to face (gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: H 首字「拄/扢」两读均不合音写 cheng，西文 bostro/allexa 亦残，仅「人面」可定，故列低置信。

entries.en: in any case; either way (it is all the same)
entries.notes: 西文 a rod~ 截断且行尾残注难辨，据 H/M「左右是」定释义。

entries.en: to go out on official business; to serve as an envoy
to go out; to go outside
to go out; to leave
to go out of the stockade or camp (gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: H 次字「築/篤」两读均不合音写 chay（音近「寨/灾」），西文 reyma/acebarse 亦残，故列低置信。

entries.en: to go out of the house; to leave home

entries.zh: 出汛；出巡汛地（巡毕回防）
entries.en: to set out on the scheduled coastal patrol (of the fleet) and return
to come out in public; to show oneself, come to the fore
entries.notes: 西文 escandido 存疑，据 H/M「出头」定释义。

entries.zh: 平安脱险；从火中安然脱身
entries.en: to come out of the fire safe and sound; to escape danger unharmed
entries.notes: H「捍/扞」两读义近，据西文 salir en paz del fuego 定释义。

entries.en: to come to light; to be revealed, to appear
to go out to court; for the royal Audiencia to sit in session
for the sun to rise, to come out
entries.notes: H 首字「白/日」两读、音写 xit 定为「日」，次字 chio 对应汉字未定，故列中等置信。

entries.en: to collapse; to crumble down (of walls or structures)
entries.notes: H 首字「贓/臧」两读均不合音写 zo（音近「坐/遭」），西文 miuras 残疑，仅据「落」与西文拟坍塌，故列低置信。

entries.zh: 出身；（由奴仆）升到官人身份
entries.en: one's social origin; to rise from slave to mandarin
entries.notes: 西文缩写 p/a 两读不碍词义，故列中等置信。
